fields.label: Calculation Method
fields.options:
26-Day Basis
30-Day Basis
Actual Calendar Days
Actual Working Days
Fixed Monthly Salary
fields.description: Daily Rate = Monthly Salary / Divisor. 26-Day and 30-Day use a fixed divisor. Actual Calendar Days uses the days in the payroll period. Actual Working Days uses scheduled working days in the period (excluding weekly offs and holidays). Fixed Monthly Salary pays full salary to full-period employees without attendance deduction; partial periods are prorated by calendar days.

fields.label: Proration Basis
fields.description: For employees not in service for the full period. Working Days pays attended working days and paid leave only. Calendar Days also pays weekly offs and holidays within the service period (as per the paid settings above).
